items.text: Far too many have experienced a loss to cancer. Today as we mark #WorldCancerDay–we remember those we’ve lost, reflect on how far we’ve come in detection & treatment & recommit to doing more. As we announced in reigniting the Cancer Moonshot it’s time to end cancer as we know it.

Providing children with school meals helps reduce child hunger. But right now, Mitch McConnell is blocking waivers that allow for greater flexibility and guaranteed access to these school meals. It’s unconscionable. Childhood nutrition is no place for politics.

A cancer diagnosis is challenging enough but it shouldn’t bring with it a lifetime of crushing medical debt too. These out-of-pocket costs are too high, and I’m working in Congress to bring these costs down & protect hardworking Americans.  https://t.co/InzaQb4biA

The opioid epidemic is hurting communities across MD, & it’s only gotten worse during the COVID-19 crisis. But with @POTUS’ new plan, we can chart a new path. One where we can lower the risk of overdoses and help Americans enter recovery. https://t.co/YvC9aKH4AL

Maryland’s families & communities have been ravaged by the opioid epidemic. We need solutions now. I’m working to eliminate barriers to treatment, and I support legislation like the Mainstreaming Addiction Treatment Act to help get this done. https://t.co/n17ld4wSWp

Treatment for Sickle Cell should be accessible to all who need it, but for too long that hasn’t been the case for young patients transitioning out of pediatric care. That’s why today @SenBooker & intro’d the Sickle Cell Care Expansion Act so we can finally close the care gap. https://t.co/wH5zE4d753

Declaring bankruptcy. 
Forgoing medical treatment. 
Liquidating their retirement. 
 
Americans shouldn’t have to go to these extreme lengths to get out of medical debt. We can & we must do more. And a good start would be taking up the bills I’ve introduced to tackle this crisis.

When you’re ill, a quick diagnosis can stand between life & death. But too many Americans face misdiagnoses that can end w/ tragic consequences. That’s why @SenatorLujan, @RepDonBeyer, @RepKimSchrier & I intro’d the Improving Diagnosis in Medicine Act ⤵️ https://t.co/xjMxZT35z7

Monkeypox is a global emergency and should not be taken lightly. I encourage folks to take the steps recommended below to protect themselves & their loved ones. We must work together with our international partners to combat this disease. https://t.co/ARspHvAoe0

After finally getting a little sleep, it’s a great day to talk about the Inflation Reduction Act and what these Medicare provisions and bold climate investments are going to do for our country. The countdown is on until this passes the House & heads to the President’s desk. https://t.co/zxtUmGu2on

This is the consequence of the extreme reproductive health care bans that Republicans want Americans to ignore. Patients should be able to get the treatment they need: whether that’s reproductive care or access to the meds that are best suited for them. https://t.co/ehW6JCBMp4

No American with sickle cell disease should struggle to get the full scope of care they need.

That’s why today, @SenBooker & I are introducing the Sickle Cell Disease Treatment Centers Act w/ @RepBarbaraLee & @RepDannyDavis to close gaps in care. https://t.co/5x217jJldK

Advancements in the treatment of sickle cell disease wouldn't be possible without the courage of MD brothers John & Brett Paul. Alongside the @hopkinsheme team I met with their family today, & shared our deep gratitude – we will never forget John’s & Brett’s extraordinary legacy. https://t.co/bnk5hk3QCI

Saudi Arabia’s treatment of this US citizen is appalling – as are their other human rights abuses & their efforts to aid & abet Putin’s war machine by boosting his oil profits. Tough rhetoric isn't enough. They need to be held accountable – time to stop the coddling.

Our breast cancer survivor community inspires us all with their strength & determination.
 
Honored to join #makingstridesbaltimore today for push to boost early detection, ensure access to treatment & invest in medical research to conquer cancer! https://t.co/rVWTbw1vUF

We must continue to stand with protestors in Iran demanding freedom & justice. The so-called “morality police” should be totally abolished – not just in words, but in action – & the Iranian people able to exercise their universal right to life, liberty & the pursuit of happiness.

Mental health care IS health care — and we’ve taken action to ensure more Americans can get the care they need, investing $20B+ in:

-Community mental health services.
-Pediatric mental health care.
-Substance abuse prevention & treatment.

While we're talking about budgets, here's what MAGA Republicans want to cut in theirs:  ❌Medicaid expansion ❌Veterans benefits ❌Affordable clean energy ❌Nutrition assistance ❌Student loan relief  All while fighting for more tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy.

.@POTUS is right: mental health care IS health care. It should be as easy to seek treatment for a mental health issue as it is for a broken bone.

Glad to see this move to ensure more Americans can get the mental health care they need, when they need it. https://t.co/LPmgw0DWDh

In a MAGA Shutdown, nearly 7 million mothers, infants & children could lose access to vital WIC nutrition assistance — including over 123,000 Marylanders. We're talking about babies and their mothers going hungry.

Tell Speaker McCarthy to stop playing to the MAGA crowd.

Gaza hospitals are at a breaking point. Premature babies have died from inability to generate oxygen—many more at risk. Pregnant women+hundreds of severely injured civilians trapped. For the sake of humanity, we need a long enough cessation of hostilities to save these innocents.

Days ago, the IDF cleared a security plan to allow fuel for desalination plants for water and generators for hospitals. The Netanyahu Cabinet has not approved it. The inhumane restrictions cited here will simply perpetuate the suffering of innocents in Gaza.

This is a big milestone in the fight against sickle cell disease & a reminder of what’s possible when we mobilize federal $$ to find treatments & cures.

I won’t stop fighting to pass my bills to expand sickle cell disease research & improve access to treatment as we seek a cure.

A record-breaking 20 MILLION Americans have enrolled in health care coverage through the Affordable Care Act. The ACA is keeping more Americans covered and healthy than ever before — and it's not too late to enroll for 2024!

#GetCovered by 1/15➡️https://t.co/fP4w0JhBLV https://t.co/xhMneWmrHB

A record # of MDers got health coverage this year—incl. many from historically underinsured populations. We successfully lowered premiums in the Inflation Reduction Act to make health care under the ACA even more affordable. Zero Rs voted for it—but MDers are seeing the benefits.
